name: Ancient Tome
description: A weathered book bound in cracked leather, filled with pages of cryptic text in a language few can read.

actions.label: Examine
actions.result: You look at the ancient tome and notice strange runes etched along the spine. The pages are yellowed with age.

actions.label: Read
actions.result: You attempt to decipher the cryptic text inside...

trigger.success: You successfully translate a passage revealing the location of a hidden vault beneath the city.
trigger.failure: The script is ancient and too complex for you to decipher.

actions.label: Pick Up
actions.result: You reach out and grasp the tome...

trigger.success: You feel a faint tingle as you lift it but nothing else happens.
trigger.failure: A burst of necrotic energy surges through you. You take 1d6 psychic damage.
